class.name: IfcFaceOuterBound
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992: A face outer bound is a special subtype of face bound which carries the additional semantics of defining an outer boundary on the face. No more than one boundary of a face shall be of this type. NOTE Corresponding ISO 10303 entity: face_outer_bound. Please refer to ISO/IS 10303-42:1994, p. 139 for the final definition of the formal standard. HISTORY New class
